title: 第41章 域名之争
content_zh:
第41章 域名之争-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

存书签

下一章

张伟波，一名普通的IT男。

他于1999年注册域weibo.com

注册这个域名的时候，张伟波没有想太多。

而他注册这个域名的理由很简单，他的名字拼音双拼就叫weibo

“我注册这个域名的初衷是“名字保护”，当时注册域名很便宜。”

“没想到现在居然有人愿意收购。”

静静听完他讲话，戴着金丝镶边眼镜的魏沐开口说道：“估计你想不到，当时随便注册的域名能给你带来一笔财富。”

“是的，我很感谢你的收购。”

张伟波对买家的报价非常满意。

要知道，目前双拼域名的价格普遍在8万-50万区间，具体取决于域名含义和行业关联性。

比如“房产”类域名fang.com在2008年的估值约为30万左右。

但是，张伟波手上的域名可没有这么贵。

因为weibo.com域名现在没有任何含义，也没有和任何行业挂钩。

新浪微博明年才上线。

魏沐开的价格足够有诚意。

于是，两人当天就达成交易，魏老板顺利拿下weibo.com

在交易完成以后，张伟波还是忍不住问道：“魏先生，请问你为什么要购买这个域名。”

魏沐当然不能说为了赚钱。

今天花15万买域名，到2010年新浪愿意花800万购买。

于是，他微微抬头，朝着窗外看了一眼，目光充满爱意。

“我有一个朋友很喜欢这个域名，我想买来送给她。”

懂了，送女朋友！！

张伟波虽然是个IT男，但是他已经结婚，对方的眼神做不得假，一看就是坠入爱河的男人。

“那祝你和那位朋友早日修成正果。”

待对方离开咖啡厅，魏老板伸了伸懒腰，摘下装逼用的金边眼镜。

大告成功！！

除此之外，他还将拿下weibo.com.cn以及weibo.cn这两个域名，完成对新浪的全面截胡。

明年9月，新浪微博上线，然后他们就会意识到域名的重要性。

原时空，新浪微博在2010年以800万从张伟波手上收购weibo.com这个域名。

说白了，张伟波只是一个普通人，800万对于他来说是一笔天文数字。

新浪微博就是这么想的，快速出手快速拿下，不给竞争对手反应时间。

现在域名到了他的手上，必须狠狠敲一笔。

互联网公司都是阔佬，有的是钱。

如果新浪微博不愿意提高价码，他还可以卖给别人。

毕竟微博这款产品，不只有新浪一家在做。

晚上回到住的小区，魏沐才想起来魔都的事情。

他打电话给袁红，后者很快接通。

Zhang Weibo, an ordinary IT man.

He registered the domain weibo.com in 1999

When registering this domain name, Zhang Weibo didn't think too much.

The reason why he registered this domain name is very simple. His name in pinyin is Weibo.

"My original intention of registering this domain name was for "name protection". At that time, domain name registration was very cheap."

“I didn’t expect that someone would be willing to acquire it now.”

After listening to him quietly, Wei Mu, who was wearing gold-rimmed glasses, said, "You may not have imagined that a casually registered domain name at that time could bring you a fortune."

"Yes, I appreciate the acquisition."

Zhang Weibo is very satisfied with the buyer's offer.

You should know that the current price of Shuangpin domain names is generally in the range of 80,000-500,000, depending on the meaning of the domain name and industry relevance.

For example, the "real estate" domain name fang.com was valued at about 300,000 in 2008.

However, the domain name Zhang Weibo holds is not that expensive.

Because the domain name weibo.com currently has no meaning and is not linked to any industry.

Sina Weibo will not be launched until next year.

Wei Mukai's price is sincere enough.

As a result, the two reached a deal that day, and Boss Wei successfully acquired weibo.com

After the transaction was completed, Zhang Weibo couldn't help but ask: "Mr. Wei, may I ask why you purchased this domain name."

Of course Wei Mu couldn't say it was for making money.

Today, I spend 150,000 yuan to buy a domain name, but by 2010, Sina will be willing to spend 8 million yuan to buy it.

So, he raised his head slightly and glanced out the window, his eyes full of love.

"I have a friend who likes this domain name very much, and I want to buy it for her."

Got it, give it to your girlfriend!!

Although Zhang Weibo is an IT man, he is already married, and the look in his eyes cannot be faked. At first glance, he is a man who has fallen in love.

"Then I wish you and that friend will achieve success as soon as possible."

After the other party left the cafe, Boss Wei stretched his waist and took off the gold-rimmed glasses he used to show off.

Big success!!

In addition, he will also take over the two domain names weibo.com.cn and weibo.cn to complete the comprehensive interception of Sina.

In September next year, Sina Weibo will go online, and then they will realize the importance of domain names.

In the original time and space, Sina Weibo acquired the domain name weibo.com from Zhang Weibo for 8 million in 2010.

To put it bluntly, Zhang Weibo is just an ordinary person, and 8 million is an astronomical sum for him.

This is what Sina Weibo thinks, to take action quickly and win quickly without giving competitors time to react.

Now that the domain name is in his hands, he must give it a serious blow.

Internet companies are all wealthy people, and they have a lot of money.

If Sina Weibo is unwilling to raise the price, he can sell it to others.

After all, Sina is not the only one making Weibo products.

After returning to the community where he lived in the evening, Wei Mu remembered what happened in the Magic City.

He called Yuan Hong, who quickly answered the call.
